eyebrow: Every .cpp file passes through all four

code:
g++ -E pricer.cpp -o pricer.i
g++ -S pricer.i  -o pricer.s
g++ -c pricer.s  -o pricer.o
g++ pricer.o     -o pricer
caption: Preprocess, compile, assemble, link — one flag isolates each stage.
-std picks the standard, -O2 optimizes, -Wall -Wextra surface bugs early.
